_note: Append-only per-gate outcome log (roadmap Theme 8 measurement spine). Two row kinds. VERDICT rows (default; ONE per GATE per slice, appended via gate_log.py | vault_edit append, SVW-1 locked) carry findings_count/_real/_noise → PRECISION. reality_contact ranks the gate by what it touches that is NOT the model: high = real env/device/data (risk-spike, validate-slice); medium = real code graph (drift-check); low = the model grading the model (critique, critique-review, code-review). RECALL rows (kind:"miss", emitted by /reflect Step 3b) record a real issue the owning gate SHOULD have caught but MISSED — surfaced in build/validate or post-ship; they carry severity + caught_by, NO verdict/findings_count. Per-gate recall = catches/(catches+misses), catches = Σ findings_real on that gate's verdict rows. Readers (/pulse, /critic-calibrate) MUST filter kind:"miss" OUT of the precision/raised math. mode/tier optional. Surfaced as the per-gate hit-rate line in /pulse.
